title: Sphinx Cat Artist
description: A vibrant surreal scene featuring a purple sphinx cat with multiple eyes, wearing a decorated robe and sitting on a wooden platform in dark reflective water. The cat is drawing in an open sketchbook with a yellow pencil while surrounded by glowing crystals, cherry blossoms, koi fish swimming in the air, Japanese torii gates, skeletal fish, and a large cracked moon with green and red cosmic swirls in the background.
prompt: A purple sphinx cat with multiple glowing eyes and ornate patterns on its body, wearing a detailed robe, sits on a wooden platform in dark water and draws in an open sketchbook with a pencil. Floating koi fish, cherry blossom branches, glowing blue crystals, small torii gates, and skeletal fish surround it. In the background is a large cracked glowing moon, swirling green and red cosmic patterns with dripping effects, and dark reflective water showing the cat's reflection.
